confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Phnom Penh price levels for July 2026; no live booking pages or menus were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are the most reliable; hotel and hostel anchors are less certain, and July is rainy season, so rates may run somewhat below peak. Cocktail and wine were set from beer using a local price relationship (roughly 4x and 5x a draft beer). The FX rate comes from a search result that attributes the figure to the RBA overview page; I did not open that page directly, so verify it on rba.gov.au before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: lower-cost Southeast Asian tourist cities, with Siem Reap and budget-to-mid-range Vietnamese and Thai city pricing as reference points. Phnom Penh prices are commonly quoted in USD. No specific comparable listings were inspected.
